Central Spotlight

TWO SENATE SPOTS ARE OPEN

This spring, there are TWO Senate seats open. Applications are open this morning and will close
FRIDAY, Jan 23rd at NOON!
The application can be found in your email or via myCentral under Campus Life > Student Senate.

Consider joining Senate if you want to be a student leader, make change on campus, and serve on faculty committees! HOORAH!

EnVision Vision Board Night

Join us for Vision Board Night and kick off the semester by creating your own vision board. All materials will be provided. We’ll be in the
Maytag Atrium on Saturday, the 24th, from 7–9 PM
. We can’t wait to see you there!

Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement
Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.

Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.
